task: Load exported Java function declarations from staged ABI-v10 source-free providers.
observation: The v10 validator accepted framed records, but the compiler's function loader only scanned the v9 contract sections; Java's v10 writer also emitted abbreviated function payloads without parameter and generic-body facts. A verified container could therefore contribute no usable generic function to the importing program.
impact: The staged v10 writer now stores complete existing v9 function declaration payloads in framed function records, and the loader decodes those records after container verification. A synthetic provider test checks parameter/access and generic-body restoration. This does not cover all ABI-v10 record classes or Margo package integration.

resolution.summary: Exported staged-v10 function records now load through the existing function importer; full v10 source-free semantics remain incomplete.
